title: Emerald Saver Account: Adding authorized users
summary: This document explains how to add authorized users to an Emerald Saver Account: you can add up to 3 users total, assign roles/permissions for viewing, transferring, and approvals, then confirm/save to send an invitation for secure access. It also states same-day ACH transfers are not available for this tier (enabled: No).
faqs: How many authorized users can I add to my Emerald Saver account?
What roles and permissions can I set for each authorized user (viewing, transferring, approvals)?
What are the steps to add an authorized user from my business profile?
Do Emerald Saver account authorized users support same-day ACH transfers?
When I add a user, what happens after I confirm and save?
What are best practices for keeping authorized-user access secure within the 3-user limit?
